comment: Shared conformance vectors for the Go (engine/text) and TS (client/src/text) text CRDTs. Each case runs a script of steps over named replicas, then asserts checks. Indices count Unicode code points over visible text. encodedHex pins the canonical encoding, fragmentHex the canonical delta-state fragment encoding (format version 2) — both languages must produce identical bytes. Harnesses must verify every merge step both ways (merge(a,b) == merge(b,a) byte-for-byte), the same for mergeFragments, and that fragments re-encode stably through decode.
rejectComment: rejects lists documents both decoders must refuse, with the exact error each must produce — the two are only interchangeable if they accept the same set of bytes. hex is the payload (empty means empty input); kind is "doc" (default, run through the document decoder) or "anchor" (through the standalone anchor decoder).

cases.comment: Deleting the text between two same-value marks of the same key joins them: resolution walks visible characters, so a gap made entirely of tombstones does not interrupt the run. Mark resolution confines each key to the stretches its own ops cover, and this is the case where those stretches must still be treated as contiguous.

cases.name: two marks of one key separated by visible text stay two spans
cases.comment: The counterpart of the case above: a live character between the two stretches does break the run, so they must not be joined.

plainStringComment: plainStrings pins the plain-string value form (format version 3): the tag byte followed by the text's UTF-8 bytes. Harnesses must verify that encoding text yields hex, that decoding hex yields text, and that the plain-text read path returns text for hex — the same path that returns a document's visible text, since a reader holding a field value cannot know which form it has.
